description: Functions with the same domain which differ at only finitely many arguments have ranges with finite symmetric difference; one range is coinfinite exactly when the other is.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.finite_modification_ranges.{u} {A : Type u} {f g : A → ℕ}
  (h : f =ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] g) :
  (Set.range f \ Set.range g ∪ Set.range g \ Set.range f).Finite ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.CoinfiniteRange f ↔ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.CoinfiniteRange g)
